Good evening, The homeowners association of Four Seasons Resorts Nevis has filed a lawsuit against Nevis Peak Holdings. Nevis Peak owns the luxury resort and surrounding property, and Cascade, the family office of Bill Gates, owns Nevis Peak. The resort’s homeowners are disgruntled that, despite the steep fee to get in the door, the five-star property has been allowed to fall into disrepair. It’s not the first time the resort’s homeowners have sued. Forbes estimates Gates is worth $108 billion—much more than the $100 million in damages the association is claiming. Learn more here. Caption: 

“The last industrial revolution was the manufacturing of software. Previously it was manufacturing of electricity. Now we are manufacturing intelligence.”
_— Jensen Huang_



----------View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/953c31e9-4779-4128-9aad-c737ab421b13/unnamed-4.png?t=1786735211)
Caption: 

# Friday charts: How much intelligence is too much?

Nvidia co-founder Jensen Huang believes that investing in AI infrastructure is a reinforcing feedback loop: “More compute creates better AI; better AI creates more usage; more usage creates more revenue; and more revenue drives more compute,” he [posted](https://x.com/JensenHuang/status/2086934705207959965?s=20) this week on his new X account.

Huang sells semiconductors, so this might be a sales pitch. But it might also give him a unique perspective on AI.** **In the Moore’s Law era of rapidly improving semiconductors (which Huang has personally done so much to perpetuate), more investment led to better and cheaper chips, which made the chips more useful, which sold more chips, which funded more investment, which led to better chips.

Investment in large language models might work the same way.

But there are some big counterexamples, too — like agriculture and manufacturing.

The reason hardly any of us are farmers anymore is because investment in technology like tractors and fertilizer expanded the supply of food far faster than we could eat it (much as we’ve tried).

More recently, it’s also the primary reason why fewer and fewer of us work in factories. “Faster productivity growth interacting with unresponsive demand has been the dominant force behind the declining share of employment in manufacturing in the United States and other industrial economies,” one [study](https://www.nber.org/papers/w24151?utm_source=chatgpt.com) found.

No matter how cheap and abundant manufactured goods become, there are only so many cars, refrigerators, TVs, and couches we can use (try as we might).

Now the same thing is happening in China, which is producing so many cars for export, there are [not enough ships](https://www.wsj.com/business/logistics/there-arent-enough-ships-to-handle-chinas-booming-car-exports-d2b66787?utm_source=chatgpt.com) to carry them abroad. As manufacturing productivity outpaces consumption, Chinese workers are shifting into the gig economy, much as American workers once shifted from farming to manufacturing, and then from manufacturing to servi

Happy Friday good degens! Lots of stuff going on!
Let’s get after it!
As always… stats/alerts/etc at top and tweets/news/links/videos/etc at bottom… and all tweets are hyperlinked so just click on them to pull them up on Twitter/X!

Spotlight
Big news from our friends at @DeFiSaver [ https://substack.com/redirect/dce89a57-5f8b-4216-bb00-82559364cce3?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] - who just announced their new Liquidation Protection feature! 
As stated in their thread below:
“Today we are introducing Liquidation Protection.
A minimal automation option that we believe every lending protocol user should enable to avoid liquidation penalties at all times.
Available now across all of the top DeFi protocols...
Liquidation Protection does one thing and one thing only: 
It monitors your position 24/7 and if its health drops too low, it makes an instant automated adjustment where it uses a small part of your collateral to clear part of your debt. 
Given that all the lending protocols in DeFi today work with overcollateralised loans, this will always result in an increased health factor of your position…”
This upgrade builds upon technology and capabilities that already existed within DeFi Saver, and makes the Liquidation Protection mechanism extremely robust and easy to view and engage with within the DeFi Saver UX!
Once again… DeFi Saver [ https://substack.com/redirect/b2174655-d618-4e24-b064-b9f914677fba?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] is a trustless, non-custodial protocol aggregator that allows for efficient defi position management. It integrates all the major defi greats such as Aave V3 and V4, Morpho, Euler, Compound, Spark, Sky, and others - all in one intuitive UI, and offers advanced tools catering to more experienced users!
In addition, if you missed their recent update about their extremely cool new tool called tokensaver.fyi [ https://substack.com/redirect/3ac1a639-bc60-4b53-8b76-9a060f0d5dc2?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ], make sure to check it out here [ https://substack.com/redirect/27829870-1828-447e-9665-6a443b03f25b?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ]!
And as always make sure to follow them on Twitter [ https://substack.com/redirect/dce89a57-5f8b-4216-bb00-82559364cce3?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] for more updates, and stay tuned as we continue bringing updates on everything they are shipping!
